review_text: Cafe Tavera remains a solid choice for classic Filipino seafood and comfort food near Torres Street. The Food: Definitely the highlight. Everything we ordered was delicious. The Green Mango with Bagoong and Kinilaw Medley are perfect appetizers to start your meal. Don’t miss their famous Dragon Balls (savory meat/seafood balls) - we got the 6-piece serving and they were a hit. The Fried Crab with Salted Egg was rich and flavorful, while the Baked Scallops, Buttered Shrimps, and Calamares were all fresh. We also added the Grilled Pork Liempo for some variety, and it was perfectly charred. The service is okay, though it can be a bit slow when the house is full, so patience is key. The dining area has that classic, cozy Davao ancestral home vibe, but it could use a bit of a refresh to keep up with the newer spots in the city. On-site parking is quite limited. If the small lot is full, you’ll have to do roadside parking along Camus or Avanceña Streets. Just be mindful of the "No Parking" signs to avoid towing, especially since the streets are a bit narrow. Pro-Tip for Visitors: They have private air-conditioned rooms perfect for family reunions or business dinners, as well as more intimate corners for couples. Since this is a favorite for local celebrations, be sure to book in advance, as they are often packed on weekends and holidays.

Such a satisfying meal, but the steamed pigek and the salted egg crab were definitely our absolute favorites! The sauce on both was just right—rich and incredibly flavorful without being overpowering. Everything else we ordered was also amazing: the comforting imbao soup, a rich sea cucumber and beef tendon hotpot, grilled liempo, liver bbq, and the pickled mango. It was ALL so good and super yummy!

Cafe Tavera has exceptional staff and service. Very accommodating, attentive, and friendly, making special occasions even more memorable. We had our dinner and I saw they don't offer only what you think they offer. But they have fresh seafood, flavorful dishes like chili crab, kinilaw, and King Mud Crab with salted-egg sauce, Dragon Ball which is popular here. Both indoor and outdoor setting - cozy and just enough for groups to dine in comfort. Only they have limited parking available. Some patrons have noted challenges with parking near the restaurant. Overall, Cafe Tavera is a top recommendation for those seeking authentic Filipino and Asian flavors in Davao City and they are also one of the well known cafes that serves quality food!

It's ridiculous how a restaurant charging this price would make such a basic mistake. There were tons of fruit flies and insects flying around the restaurant.
